WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Užij si to, kámo!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Hoo, boy. Now, that is the scariest game I ever been in.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Hohoho. To je nejděsivější hra, ve které jsem kdy byl.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I was NOT coded for battling aliens, unlike my friend Sergeant Calhoun.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: NEBYL jsem naprogramovaný na boj s mimozemšťany, na rozdíl od mé kamarádky seržantky Calhounové.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I love battling stuff!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Miluju boj!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Sometimes I want to battle, sometimes not.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Někdy chci bojovat, někdy ne.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I'm coded for cozy games!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jsem naprogramovaný/á na pohodové hry!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Really? I bet you have a BUNCH of medals.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Vážně? Vsadím se, že máš HROMADU medailí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: A little bit of everything, huh? I get it.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Trochu od všeho, co? Chápu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Oh yeah? I learned about those on the Internet. One of the best things about games is that there's something for everyone.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Aha, jo? O těch jsem se dozvěděl na Internetu. Jedna z nejlepších věcí na hrách je, že je v nich něco pro každého.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: BIG question. It's... big? And weird? There's lots of good stuff on it. AND lots of not-so-good stuff, too.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: VELKÁ otázka. Je... velký? A divný? Je tam hodně dobrých věcí. A TAKY hodně ne-tak-dobrých věcí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I heard it has a pretty serious infestation of "trolls," though? So you gotta be careful.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Slyšel jsem ale, že má docela vážnou nákazu "trollů"? Takže si musíš dávat pozor.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Do you use the Internet, {PlayerName}?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Používáš Internet, {PlayerName}?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Yes, I love playing games online!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Ano, zbožňuju hrát hry online!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I do lots of different activities — surfing the Internet is just one of 'em.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Dělám spoustu různých věcí — surfování na Internetu je jen jedna z nich.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Do I USE it? Ralph, you sweet summer wrecking ball.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jestli ho POUŽÍVÁM? Ralfe, ty sladká letní bouračko.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Really?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Vážně?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: You ever played Slaughter Race? That's Vanellope's new game.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Hrál/a jsi někdy Slaughter Race? To je nová hra Vanellope.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: That's cool! I didn't know you were a surfer!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: To je super! Nevěděl jsem, že jsi surfař/ka!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: What? I know the Internet's popular but... is it really THAT popular?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Cože? Vím, že je Internet populární, ale... je fakt TAK populární?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Is it?!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Opravdu?!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Oh, I was just thinkin' about how nice the wildlife is around here.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Ó, jen jsem přemýšlel, jak pěkná je tu příroda.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Don't get me wrong: I love Fix-It Felix Jr., but we don't have any animals. And the ones here are so small and cute!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Necháp mě špatně: miluju Fix-It Felix Jr., ale nemáme tam žádná zvířata. A tady jsou tak malá a roztomilá!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Do you have a favorite animal in the Valley?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Máš oblíbené zvíře v Údolí?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Squirrels.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Veverky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Rabbits.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Králíky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Sea Turtles.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Mořské želvy.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Something else...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Něco jiného...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: HA! I love those little guys. Talk about nutty!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: HA! Miluju ty malé chlapíky. To je teprv oříšek!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: They sure seem sweet — and so fast too. They always run away when I try to get a closer look at 'em.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Vypadají fakt mile — a jsou tak rychlí. Vždycky utečou, když se na ně chci podívat zblízka.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Yes! They're pretty shy, though. One of these days, I'll get one to come out of its shell for me... Hold on! You know I didn't mean like really leave its shell, right?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Ano! Jsou ale docela plaché. Jednoho dne jednu přiměju vylézti z krunýře... Počkej! Víš, že jsem nemyslel opravdu opustit krunýř, že jo?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Raccoons.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Mývaly.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Crocodiles.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Krokodýly.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Sunbirds.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Kolibříky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Something else...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Něco jiného...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Gotta love the raccoons!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Mývaly jsou skvělí!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: They have those cute little hands. Nimble little critters, aren't they?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Mají takové roztomilé malé ručičky. Šikovní tvorečkové, co?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Yeah, they sure make things in the Glade interesting.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jo, rozhodně oživují Mýtinu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Scaly scamperers, that's what they are!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Šupinatí uličníci, to jsou!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: They're so colorful!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jsou tak pestří!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I never get close enough to pet one, but they look real nice around the flowers.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Nikdy se nedostanu dost blízko, abych jednoho pohladil, ale vypadají moc hezky u květin.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Foxes.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Lišky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Ravens.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Havrany.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I love them ALL!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Miluju je VŠECHNY!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Ooh, sometimes I worry about their little paws gettin' cold in the snow in the Frosted Heights.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Úú, občas se bojím, že jim malé tlapky mrznou ve sněhu v Mrazivých výšinách.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Should we learn knitting to make 'em boots or mittens... or bittens?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Měli bychom se naučit plést, abychom jim udělali botičky nebo palčáky... nebo palčičky?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Well, they definitely make the Forgotten Lands creepier.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: No, rozhodně dělají Zapomenuté země ještě strašidelnější.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: ... Don't tell anyone — especially Vanellope — but that place gives me the heebies AND the jeebies!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: ... Nikomu to neříkej — hlavně Vanellope — ale to místo mi nahání husí kůži!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Ya know, you're right, {PlayerName}. How could anyone pick just ONE favorite animal?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Víš, máš pravdu, {PlayerName}. Jak si může někdo vybrat jen JEDNO oblíbené zvíře?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Ooh! I got an idea! I'll make a mini-game for myself and try to give 'em ALL treats!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Úú! Mám nápad! Udělám si mini-hru a pokusím se je VŠECHNY nakrmit!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Oh, I think I heard about that one on the Internet.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Ó, myslím, že jsem o tom slyšel na Internetu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Always wanted to play, but my hands are so big it's hard to make the little signs.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Vždycky jsem si chtěl zahrát, ale moje ruce jsou tak velké, že je těžké dělat ta malá gesta.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Let's play right now!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Pojďme si zahrát hned teď!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: There are lots of other games to play!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Je spousta jiných her na hraní!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: You're perfect just the way you are.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jsi dokonalý přesně takový, jaký jsi.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Really? Sure!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Vážně? Jasně!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: If I remember the rules correctly, <Lore>paper beats rock, rock beats scissors, and scissors beat paper</Lore>.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Pokud si pravidla pamatuju správně, <Lore>papír porazí kámen, kámen porazí nůžky a nůžky porazí papír</Lore>.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: So think of which one you'll choose, and we'll say it out loud.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Tak si rozmysli, co zvolíš, a řekneme to nahlas.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: On the count of three! One... two... three!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Na tři! Jedna... dva... tři!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Rock!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Kámen!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Paper!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Papír!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Scissors!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Nůžky!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: ROCK!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: KÁMEN!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Whoa, we both picked rock! I guess we call it a tie.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Páni, oba jsme zvolili kámen! Asi remíza.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: ROCK! Aww...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: KÁMEN! Aw...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: You win. Nice one, {PlayerName}!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Vyhráváš. Pěkné, {PlayerName}!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: ROCK!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: KÁMEN!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Ha! My rock beats your scissors. I win. Good game!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Ha! Můj kámen porazí tvé nůžky. Vyhrávám. Dobrá hra!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Wanna play again?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Chceš si zahrát znovu?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Yes, let's go again!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Ano, ještě jednou!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: I've gotta run.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Musím běžet.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Great! One... two... three...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Skvělé! Jedna... dva... tři...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Rock!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Kámen!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Paper!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Papír!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Scissors!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Nůžky!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Dynamite!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Dynamit!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Paper!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Papír!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: HA! Paper beats rock. I win!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: HA! Papír porazí kámen. Vyhrávám!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Paper!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Papír!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Great minds think alike, {PlayerName}.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Velcí duchové myslí stejně, {PlayerName}.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Paper!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Papír!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Your scissors definitely beat my paper. Nicely played.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Tvé nůžky rozhodně porazily můj papír. Dobře zahráno.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Paper— huh?!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Papír— cože?!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: What?! What kinda cheat code is that? Dynamite would explode all this stuff!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Cože?! Co je to za cheat kód? Dynamit by tohle všechno vyhodil do vzduchu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: That means I definitely win!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: To znamená, že rozhodně vyhrávám!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Sorry, that was a trick.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Promiň, to byl trik.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Now you know the cheat code too!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Teď znáš cheat kód taky!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Yeah, I guess so... I didn't know you were so tricky, {PlayerName}.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jo, asi jo... Nevěděl jsem, že jsi tak mazaný/á, {PlayerName}.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Well, you definitely got me!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: No, rozhodně jsi mě dostal/a!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Hey, you're RIGHT.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Hej, máš PRAVDU.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Have you seen Vanellope? I bet she doesn't know about dynamite yet!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Viděl/a jsi Vanellope? Vsadím se, že ještě neví o dynamitu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: No problem. Don't work too hard, okay?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Žádný problém. Nepřepracuj se, jo?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Sure. Vanellope and I've been playing a non-stop game of hide-and-seek for DAYS now.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Jasně. Vanellope a já hrajeme nepřetržitou schovávanou už NĚKOLIK dní.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Ooh, I should get back to looking for her. Where IS she...?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Úú, měl bych jít hledat. Kde JE...?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.en: Aw thanks, {PlayerName}. Right back at ya!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Discussions_Dis.cz: Aw díky, {PlayerName}. Taky!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_GiftThanks_Happ.en: Aw, you didn't have to. But I sure am glad you did!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_GiftThanks_Happ.cz: Aw, to jsi nemusel/a. Ale jsem fakt rád, žes to udělal/a!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_GiftThanks_Happ.en: Whoa! I've never gotten anything like this before!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_GiftThanks_Happ.cz: Páni! Tohle jsem ještě nikdy nedostal!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_GiftThanks_Happ.en: Hey, this is pretty great! Thanks, {PlayerName}!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_GiftThanks_Happ.cz: Hej, to je fakt super! Díky, {PlayerName}!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: Do we have any big fruit? Ya know, like cherries the size of my fist?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Máme tady nějaké velké ovoce? Víš, třeba třešně veliké jako moje pěst?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: Is this what a vacation's like? 'Cause I gotta say, I'm likin' this no-work thing!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Takové jsou prázdniny? Protože musím říct, že se mi to nepracování líbí!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: Vanellope just gave me some kinda gem and told me it was rock candy. I almost chipped a tooth! Heh-heh, she gets me every time.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Vanellope mi právě dala nějaký drahokam a řekla, že je to cukrkandl. Skoro jsem si vylomil zub! Heh-heh, vždycky mě napálí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: So let me get this right: In Mr. McDuck's store, you give him coins, and he just gives you stuff? That's way easier than earning hearts on the Internet!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Takže abych to pochopil: V obchodě pana McDucka mu dáš mince a on ti prostě dá věci? To je mnohem jednodušší než získávat srdíčka na Internetu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: You're really handy with that Pickaxe, {PlayerName}. Me, I just use my fists.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: S tím Krumpáčem jsi fakt šikovný/á, {PlayerName}. Já prostě používám pěsti.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: There sure are a lot of animals in this place. Betcha the cleanup after 'em is QUITE a job.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Tady je fakt hodně zvířat. Vsadím se, že uklízení po nich je PĚKNÁ práce.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: Whew, I'm hungry! Think I'll head to Tiana's Palace for a snack.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Fuj, mám hlad! Asi zamířím do Tianina paláce na svačinu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.en: Whew, I'm hungry! Think I'll head to Chez Remy for a snack.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Greet.cz: Fuj, mám hlad! Asi zamířím k Remymu na svačinu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Morni.en: Mornin', {PlayerName}! What's on the main menu today?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Morni.cz: Dobré ráno, {PlayerName}! Co je dnes na hlavním menu?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Night.en: Wonder if those sparkly things up in the sky are just broken pixels...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_Night.cz: Jestlipak ty třpytivé věci nahoře na obloze jsou jen rozbité pixely...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_RainG.en: Ya think Mr. McDuck's got umbrellas in my size? Extra jumbo?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_RainG.cz: Myslíš, že pan McDuck má deštníky v mojí velikosti? Extra obří?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_SunGr.en: I'm feelin' GREAT. Let's go for a high score today!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Greetings_SunGr.cz: Cítím se SKVĚLE. Pojďme dnes na nové rekordy!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_Cancel.en: No problem. You know where to find me!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_Cancel.cz: Žádný problém. Víš, kde mě najdeš!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_EndHan.en: Well, that was a blast! Let's hang out again sometime.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_EndHan.cz: No, to byla zábava! Pojďme se zase někdy sejít.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_EndHan.en: We gotta do this again soon!
See ya! Wouldn't wanna be ya! (Heh-heh.)

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_StartH.cz: Jasně! Jsem ti v patách, kámo!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_StartH.en: You wanna hang out with ME? Sounds great!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_StartH.cz: Chceš trávit čas se MNOU? Zní to skvěle!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_StartH.en: Oh yeah, Ralph and {PlayerName}... We're gonna make a great team!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_Hangouts_StartH.cz: Ó jo, Ralph a {PlayerName}... Budeme skvělý tým!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm going to check inside Scrooge McDuck's Store. Maybe the strange, Glitchy Arcade Machine ended up there?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jdu se podívat do obchodu Scrooge McDucka. Možná ta podivná, glitchující arkádová mašina skončila tam?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm going to get a closer look at the <ActivityItem>Glitchy Arcade Machine</ActivityItem> inside Scrooge McDuck's Store.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jdu se podívat na <ActivityItem>Glitchující arkádovou mašinu</ActivityItem> v obchodě Scrooge McDucka.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'll clear away those cables around it first!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Nejdřív odtamtud odklidím ty kabely!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm going to try interacting with that weird arcade machine. I'll clear away those wires first.
Guess you should collect all the weird, glitchy bricks in the Dreamscape.
Maybe you should try giving the bricks back to the weird arcade machine in the Dreamscape?
Let's go inside Vanellope's House. Pretty sure she can help us with the machine.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Pojďme dovnitř do domu Vanellope. Jsem si celkem jistý, že nám s tou mašinou pomůže.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Not to rush you, but could ya put that old <ActivityItem>Arcade Token</ActivityItem> in the machine there? Maybe it'll unstick me!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Nechci tě popohánět, ale mohl/a bys tam vhodit ten starý <ActivityItem>Arkádový žeton</ActivityItem>? Třeba mě to odblokuje!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I think I need to make you a place to stay in the Valley, Ralph. I'll put your House somewhere.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Myslím, že ti musím v Údolí zařídit místo k bydlení, Ralfe. Někam ti postavím dům.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: You did it! I can move!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Dokázal/a jsi to! Můžu se hýbat!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm here! I'm really here!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jsem tady! Opravdu jsem tady!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: {PlayerName}, you did it! Thankyouthankyou THANK YOU!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: {PlayerName}, dokázal/a jsi to! Díkydíkydíky DÍKY!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm just glad that worked...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jsem jen rád, že to vyšlo...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Nice to have you back, Ralph!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Rád tě tu mám zpátky, Ralfe!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Great teamwork, everyone!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Skvělá týmová práce, všichni!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm glad we got a cool arcade machine!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jsem rád/a, že máme skvělou arkádovou mašinu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Well, it is nice to BE back.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: No, je fajn BÝT zpátky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Thanks, {PlayerName}. And thank you, um... What are you goin' by, these days?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Díky, {PlayerName}. A děkuju tobě, ehm... Jak si říkáš v poslední době?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten}.
Nice to meet you again, {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten}.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Těší mě znovu, {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten}.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Introductions over? Good. C'mon, Ralph, you gotta see all the cool stuff {PlayerName} has done with the place!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Představování hotovo? Dobře. Pojď, Ralfe, musíš vidět všechny ty skvělé věci, co {PlayerName} udělal/a s tímhle místem!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Right behind ya, kid! Say, {PlayerName}, you oughta keep the Fix-It Felix Jr. Game as a souvenir.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jsem hned za tebou, malá! Hele, {PlayerName}, měl/a by sis nechat hru Fix-It Felix Jr. jako suvenýr.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Thanks. It will remind me that...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Díky. Bude mi připomínat, že...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ...friendship always wins.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ...přátelství vždycky zvítězí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ...forgiveness is important!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ...odpuštění je důležité!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ...you can't beat the classics!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ...na klasiku se nedá!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Friendship ALWAYS wins.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Přátelství VŽDYCKY zvítězí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: You can say that again.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: To můžeš říct znovu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Hey, yeah. It's pretty nice, right?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Hej, jo. Je to docela fajn, ne?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Vanellope? Is that you?!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Vanellope? Jsi to ty?!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: RALPH! BUDDY! You're really here! I knew it was you!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: RALFE! KÁMO! Jsi tu doopravdy! Věděla jsem, že jsi to ty!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ... Why are you standing in that freakishly weird pose?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ... Proč stojíš v té děsivě divné póze?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I'm stuck! I can't move!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jsem zaseknutý! Nemůžu se hýbat!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: How do we unstick him?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jak ho odblokujeme?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Why are you stuck like that?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Proč jsi takhle zaseknutý?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Where have you been all this time?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Kde jsi celou tu dobu byl?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I don't know. But we gotta do something!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Nevím. Ale musíme něco udělat!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Don't worry, Ralph. We're gonna get you outta there!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Neboj, Ralfe. Dostaneme tě odtamtud!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Right, {PlayerName}? What should we do?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Že jo, {PlayerName}? Co bychom měli udělat?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: We could talk to Merlin?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Mohli bychom se poradit s Merlinem?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: We could build Ralph a House?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Mohli bychom Ralfovi postavit dům?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: We could leave him like this?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Mohli bychom ho takhle nechat?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: He knows lotsa stuff about magic, sure, but not much about video games.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Ví toho hodně o magii, jasně, ale moc ne o videohrách.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Got another idea? 'Cause I really don't wanna stay stuck like this!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Máš jiný nápad? Protože fakt nechci zůstat takhle zaseknutý!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ... He needs something extra to stabilize him here... Or whatever.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ... Potřebuje něco navíc, aby se tu stabilizoval... Nebo tak nějak.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Maybe. It probably won't work.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Možná. Pravděpodobně to nebude fungovat.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Well, he does like to eat. How 'bout we <Lore>cook him something special</Lore>?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: No, rád jí. Co kdybychom mu <Lore>uvařili něco speciálního</Lore>?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: But first, a <Lore>selfie</Lore>! Ralph, pal, this T-pose thing is HILARIOUS.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Ale nejdřív <Lore>selfíčko</Lore>! Ralfe, kámo, ta T-póza je GENIÁLNÍ.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: But he can't MOVE into the House while he's in there.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Ale nemůže se do domu NASTĚHOVAT, dokud je tam uvnitř.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: No way! That's not funny!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: V žádném případě! To není vtipné!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: I don't know, but I'm a little freaked out!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Nevím, ale trochu mě to děsí!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ... He's here but he's not here. Part of his code isn't complete in the Valley.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ... Je tu, ale zároveň tu není. Část jeho kódu není v Údolí kompletní.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: That voice is SO familiar...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Ten hlas je TAK povědomý...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: Why do you know that, {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten}?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Jak to víš, {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten}?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: ... Just a guess.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: ... Jen takový odhad.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: The Internet? I think? Probably?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Internet? Myslím? Asi?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: A long time ago, when stuff started gettin' weird around the Valley, I went to find Vanellope to be sure she was safe.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Dávno, když se v Údolí začaly dít divné věci, šel jsem najít Vanellope, abych se ujistil, že je v bezpečí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.en: But then, I think, someone <Lore>banished me</Lore>. It's a little fuzzy.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_SEC_Forg_050_SE.cz: Ale pak mě, myslím, někdo <Lore>vyhnal</Lore>. Je to trochu mlhavé.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Hey, {PlayerName}! I'm hosting a Bad-Anon meeting at my place.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Hej, {PlayerName}! Pořádám schůzku Zlých-Anonym u mě doma.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Wanna join us? I've got a pretty big surprise planned for our Valley villains.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Chceš se přidat? Mám pro naše padouchy z Údolí připravené docela velké překvapení.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Tangling with villains already? Tell me more...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Už se zapletáš s padouchy? Řekni mi víc...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'm busy. Let's talk later.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Mám co dělat. Promluvíme si později.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Well, Bad-Anon meetings really help me and my fellow video game Bad Guys understand that we're not bad guys.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: No, schůzky Zlých-Anonym mi a mým kolegům videoherním záporákům fakt pomáhají pochopit, že nejsme špatní lidi.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I thought folks here might need to remember that, so I invited Scar and Mother Gothel over.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Napadlo mě, že by si to zdejší lidé taky mohli připomenout, tak jsem pozval Jizvu a Matku Gothel.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Ralph, you're so sweet.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ralfe, jsi tak milý.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: But they ARE bad!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ale oni JSOU zlí!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: The villains don't need your help.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ti padouši tvou pomoc nepotřebují.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: What? Me? Shucks, it's nothin'.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Cože? Já? No tak, to nic není.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: C'mon. <Lore>Meet me in my House</Lore> for the first Valley Bad-Anon meeting. It's gonna be great!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Pojď, <Lore>sejdeme se v mém domě</Lore> na první schůzce Zlých-Anonym v Údolí. Bude to skvělé!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Oh sure, they are now. But maybe if someone heard them out, they'd realize they're lots more than that.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ó jistě, teď jsou. Ale možná kdyby je někdo vyslechl, zjistili by, že jsou mnohem víc.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Hey, everybody needs a little help from time to time.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Hej, každý občas potřebuje trochu pomoci.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Oh, sure. Come find me when you're a little less busy.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ó, jasně. Přijď za mnou, až budeš mít víc času.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I need to plant and water seeds for Scar on the Sunlit Plateau.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Musím zasadit a zalít semínka pro Jizvu na Sluncem zalité planině.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Ursula said she lost her <ActivityItem>Seaweed Sachet</ActivityItem> in the Glade of Trust near the willow.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Uršula říkala, že ztratila svůj <ActivityItem>Řasový pytlíček</ActivityItem> v Mýtině důvěry u vrby.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Did you find Ursula's <ActivityItem>Seaweed Sachet</ActivityItem>?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Našel/la jsi Uršulin <ActivityItem>Řasový pytlíček</ActivityItem>?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Could ya bring that little seaweed thing to Ursula for her community project?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Mohl/a bys tu řasovou věcičku donést Uršule na její komunitní projekt?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Could ya talk to Ursula about that soup she had ya make?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Mohl/a bys si promluvit s Uršulou o té polévce, co tě nechala uvařit?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Hey, meet me in my House, okay? I gotta talk to you about the challenge.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Hej, sejdeme se v mém domě, jo? Musím s tebou mluvit o té soutěži.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Did you find any clues, {PlayerName}?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Našel/la jsi nějaká vodítka, {PlayerName}?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Mother Gothel hid the trophy in the Dark Plaza. I'm heading there now.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Matka Gothel schovala sochu na Náměstí temného hradu. Mířím tam.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'm going to clear away all the Night Thorns and mess around the Do-Gooder Trophy in the Dark Plaza.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Jdu odklidit všechny trny a nepořádek kolem Trofeje dobráka na Temném náměstí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I've got to return from the Dark Plaza with the Do-Gooder Trophy.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Musím se vrátit z Temného náměstí s Trofejí dobráka.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: You did it! The trophy is back! Thanks, {PlayerName}.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Dokázal/a jsi to! Trofej je zpátky! Díky, {PlayerName}.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Could you talk to Scar? Sounds like he was pretty motivated to help the community if it means winning the trophy.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Mohl/a bys si promluvit s Jizvou? Vypadá, že byl docela motivovaný pomáhat komunitě, pokud to znamená vyhrát trofej.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Hey, I'm gonna tell Ursula about our contest. But, uh, I think we should talk to her together.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Hej, řeknu Uršule o naší soutěži. Ale, ehm, myslím, že bychom s ní měli mluvit spolu.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: You found some blue fur, huh? Maybe you should <Lore>talk to a Villager with blue fur</Lore>.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Našel/la jsi modrou srst, co? Možná bys měl/a <Lore>promluvit s Vesničanem s modrou srstí</Lore>.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Stitch said Mother Gothel pinched fur from his coat to frame him. I'm gonna talk to her and get to the bottom of this.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Stitch říkal, že Matka Gothel mu vytrhla srst z kožichu, aby ho narafičila. Promluvím si s ní a zjistím, co se stalo.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Meet me in my House. The Bad-Anon meeting's about to start.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Sejdeme se v mém domě. Schůzka Zlých-Anonym brzy začne.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Whoa! You brought back the trophy! You gotta put it some place where everybody can see it!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Páni! Přinesl/a jsi trofej! Musíš ji dát někam, kde ji všichni uvidí!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Can we talk about the trophy?!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Můžeme si promluvit o té trofeji?!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: We gotta talk and get the Bad-Anon meeting started.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Musíme si promluvit a začít schůzku Zlých-Anonym.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I need to gather the flowers I grew on the Sunlit Plateau!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Musím sklidit květiny, co jsem vypěstoval na Sluncem zalité planině!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: {PlayerName}, I... I can't believe it.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: {PlayerName}, já... nemůžu tomu uvěřit.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Scar made you do all the work; Ursula used you for a business opportunity...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Jizva tě nechal dělat veškerou práci; Uršula tě využila pro obchodní příležitost...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: ...and Mother Gothel actually stole the trophy and blamed Stitch?! I'm sorry. Guess I really screwed up.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: ...a Matka Gothel ukradla trofej a svalila to na Stitche?! Promiň. Asi jsem to fakt zvorval.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Bad-Anon was a good idea, but even good ideas don't work all the time.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Zlí-Anonym byl dobrý nápad, ale ani dobré nápady nefungují vždycky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Some folks don't want to change.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Někteří lidé se nechtějí změnit.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'm used to doing most of the work around here, TBH.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Jsem zvyklý/á dělat většinu práce tady, upřímně.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: But who would choose to be bad? Like bad for real?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ale kdo by se rozhodl být zlý? Jako opravdu zlý?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: If you ask them, Ursula, Scar, and Mother Gothel will say they've done nothing wrong.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Kdybyste se jich zeptali, Uršula, Jizva a Matka Gothel řeknou, že neudělali nic špatného.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Villains are gonna villain, Ralph.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Padouši budou vždycky padoušit, Ralfe.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I... Gee, I guess so. You know what?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Já... No, asi jo. Víš co?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: {PlayerName}, you're the best do-gooder in the Valley. You win the Do-Gooder Trophy!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: {PlayerName}, ty jsi nejlepší dobrák v Údolí. Vyhráváš Trofej dobráka!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Put it wherever you want. Maybe it'll inspire other good Villagers to do more good stuff.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Dej ji, kam chceš. Třeba to inspiruje další hodné Vesničany, aby dělali víc dobrých věcí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: So inspiring!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Tak inspirativní!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Maybe...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Možná...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Don't hold your breath.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Nezadržuj dech.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Thanks. Still, I think I'm gonna close the Valley chapter of Bad-Anon.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Díky. Ale myslím, že zavřu pobočku Zlých-Anonym v Údolí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Villains are gonna be villains, right? I've just gotta do my own thing.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Padouši budou vždycky padouši, ne? Musím si prostě dělat to svoje.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Thanks for reminding me of that, {PlayerName}. Lesson learned!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Díky, žes mi to připomněl/a, {PlayerName}. Ponaučení přijato!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Don't worry.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Neboj.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'm done with Bad-Anon in the Valley.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Se Zlými-Anonym v Údolí jsem skončil.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Well, that just proves what I was already thinkin'...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: No, to jen potvrzuje, co jsem si už myslel...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: {PlayerName}, this is bad! This is REALLY bad!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: {PlayerName}, to je zlé! To je FAKT zlé!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Not even the GOOD kind of bad, either. The Do-Gooder Trophy's gone!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ani ten DOBRÝ druh zlého. Trofej dobráka je pryč!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Let's search for clues.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Pojďme hledat vodítka.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Don't worry, Ralph; we'll find it!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Neboj se, Ralfe; najdeme ji!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: If it was taken, we can find the culprit.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Pokud ji někdo vzal, můžeme viníka najít.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Trophies don't vanish into thin air.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Trofeje se nevypařují jen tak.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I sure hope you're right, {PlayerName}. My Bad-Anon pals are not gonna like it if they find out there's no trophy.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Doufám, že máš pravdu, {PlayerName}. Moji kamarádi ze Zlých-Anonym nebudou rádi, když zjistí, že trofej není.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Taken? But this is the Valley! Folks don't steal here... Do they?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Vzal? Ale tohle je Údolí! Lidi tu nekradou... Nebo ano?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Great! We're all here. Welcome to your first Bad-Anon meeting. Okay, first thing we do is say the motto. Here, I'll lead...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Skvělé! Jsme tu všichni. Vítejte na vaší první schůzce Zlých-Anonym. Takže první, co uděláme, je říct motto. Tady, já začnu...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: "I'm bad, and that's good—"
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: "Jsem zlý, a to je dobře—"

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Pardon me, I must have received someone else's invitation. I've never done a single thing "badly" in my life.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Promiňte, musel jsem dostat pozvánku někoho jiného. Nikdy v životě jsem neudělal jedinou věc "špatně."

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I've absolutely no idea why I'm here either. Certainly the Sea Witch is a more appropriate guest.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Naprosto netuším, proč jsem tady. Určitě je vhodnějším hostem ta Mořská čarodějka.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I would've thought her ridiculous human form would let her stride right on in, as she always does.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Myslel bych, že její směšná lidská podoba by jí umožnila nakráčet dovnitř, jak to vždycky dělá.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Wh— Okay. Good point. I'll talk to Ursula after the meeting. Now, can we get back on track?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Co— Dobře. Dobrá poznámka. Promluvím si s Uršulou po schůzce. Teď se můžeme vrátit k věci?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Listen to Ralph...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Poslechněte si Ralpha...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: He wants to help you.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Chce vám pomoct.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Give him a chance to talk.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Dejte mu šanci promluvit.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: It's going to be hilarious.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Bude to vtipné.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: {PlayerName}'s right!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: {PlayerName} má pravdu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Um, let's skip the motto for today. What would you say is your number one problem in the Valley?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Ehm, přeskočme dnes motto. Co byste řekli, že je váš největší problém v Údolí?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: That's easy. No one acknowledges my intellectual superiority and rightful place as king.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: To je snadné. Nikdo neuznává mou intelektuální nadřazenost a právoplatné místo krále.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: What ISN'T a problem?! Everyone blames me for the most ridiculous things.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Co NENÍ problém?! Všichni mě obviňují z těch nejsměšnějších věcí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Scar, all you do is sulk and scheme.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Jizvo, děláš jen to, že se mračíš a strojíš intriky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Take the hint, Mother Gothel.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Pochop narážku, Matko Gothel.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'm with these two. It's a Valley of Goody Two-shoes.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Souhlasím s těmihle dvěma. Je to Údolí svatoušků.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: And why shouldn't I? I get the lion's share of the suffering.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: A proč bych neměl? Dostávám lví podíl utrpení.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: OKAY, okay. I'll just come out and say it: If you "villains" did nice things for the Villagers, everybody would like you more!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: DOBŘE, dobře. Řeknu to na rovinu: Kdybyste vy "padouši" dělali hezké věci pro Vesničany, všichni by vás měli radši!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: So I'm announcing a contest: Whoever does the MOST good stuff for the Valley gets that trophy over there. The <ActivityItem>Do-Gooder Trophy</ActivityItem>!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Takže vyhlašuji soutěž: Kdo udělá NEJVÍC dobrých věcí pro Údolí, dostane tamtu trofej. <ActivityItem>Trofej dobráka</ActivityItem>!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Like community service? Great idea!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Jako komunitní služba? Skvělý nápad!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I guess good deeds for a trophy are still good deeds...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Asi dobré skutky za trofej jsou pořád dobré skutky...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Anyone else hear the roar of impending disaster?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Slyší ještě někdo řev blížící se katastrofy?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Whew! Gotta say, I'm pretty relieved you think so.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Fuj! Musím říct, že jsem fakt rád, že si to myslíš.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Will you help mentor Scar and Mother Gothel with their projects?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Pomůžeš mentorovat Jizvu a Matku Gothel s jejich projekty?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'd love to!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Rád/a!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I'll keep an eye on them.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Budu je hlídat.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: If I must...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Když musím...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I've no need of a mentor, dear. In fact, I believe I'll measure my mantle for that trophy right now.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Nepotřebuji mentora, drahoušku. Vlastně si myslím, že si hned změřím krb na tu trofej.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: You really shouldn't bother. I plan to use it to scare away that annoying WALL·E creature the next time he brings me one of his "treasures."
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Opravdu byste se neměli obtěžovat. Plánuji ji použít k zastrašení toho otravného tvora WALL·E, až mi příště přinese jeden ze svých "pokladů."

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Great? Great! That's... kind of... the spirit! {PlayerName}, if you help Scar with his <Lore>community service</Lore> project, I'll talk to Ursula.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Skvělé? Skvělé! To je... tak trochu... ten duch! {PlayerName}, pokud pomůžeš Jizvovi s jeho <Lore>komunitním projektem</Lore>, já si promluvím s Uršulou.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Come find me when you're done! I'll be with her.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Přijď za mnou, až budeš hotov/a! Budu u ní.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: I knew you'd get it!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Věděl jsem, že to pochopíš!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Aw, c'mon {PlayerName}. I really think this'll work.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Aw, no tak, {PlayerName}. Fakt si myslím, že to bude fungovat.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Would you please stop mumbling, {PlayerName}?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Mohl/a bys přestat mumlat, {PlayerName}?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Well... Maybe it would help if they were NICE to the Goody Two-shoes.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: No... Možná by pomohlo, kdyby byli HODNÍ na ty svatoušky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Thanks, {PlayerName}.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Díky, {PlayerName}.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: Thanks... I think.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Díky... myslím.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.en: She's probably sulking about being waterbound and brewing potions in that noxious cauldron of hers.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_010_VL.cz: Asi schmutní, že je uvězněná ve vodě a vaří lektvary v tom svém odporném kotli.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hey {PlayerName}, you're just in time! I've got a whole day of mini-games planned for me, you, and Vanellope.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hej {PlayerName}, přicházíš právě včas! Mám celý den mini-her naplánovaný pro mě, tebe a Vanellope.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: There's even a super cool prize for the winner!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: A je tu i super skvělá cena pro vítěze!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I like prizes! Tell me more.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Mám rád/a ceny! Řekni mi víc.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Let's talk later, Ralph.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Promluvíme si později, Ralfe.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Well, the prize is a surprise, BUT I can tell you about the first mini-game.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: No, cena je překvapení, ALE můžu ti říct o první mini-hře.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I thought we'd start off with a <Lore>dessert-eating contest</Lore>!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Napadlo mě, že bychom začali <Lore>soutěží v pojídání dezertů</Lore>!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I love mini-games!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Miluju mini-hry!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I love desserts!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Miluju dezerty!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I want to know what the special prize is!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Chci vědět, co je ta speciální cena!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I mean, who doesn't, right?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: No, kdo by je nemiloval, že jo?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Say, would ya mind picking up the cakes I ordered from <Lore>Tiana</Lore> for the contest?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hele, nevadilo by ti vyzvednout dorty, co jsem objednal od <Lore>Tiany</Lore> na tu soutěž?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I'll get Vanellope, and then we can start!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Já seženu Vanellope a pak můžeme začít!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I'll give you a hint: It's one prize, but it's always WAY more than one.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Dám ti nápovědu: Je to jedna cena, ale je to vždycky MNOHEM víc než jedna.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Okay, but don't wait too long! This prize is gonna blow your socks off!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Dobře, ale nečekej moc dlouho! Tahle cena ti vyrazí dech!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hey, {PlayerName}, put those cakes on the table in my House, would ya?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hej, {PlayerName}, mohl/a bys položit ty dorty na stůl v mém domě?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: You gotta catch a fish for our mini-game, {PlayerName}! What are you waiting for?!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Musíš chytit rybu na naši mini-hru, {PlayerName}! Na co čekáš?!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Vanellope seems weirdly confused about this game. I'm gonna go talk to her.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Vanellope vypadá divně zmatená z téhle hry. Půjdu si s ní promluvit.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Did you get everything you need to make our ads for the scavenger hunt?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Máš všechno, co potřebuješ na výrobu reklam na hledání pokladů?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Did you make those ads for the scavenger hunt?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Udělal/a jsi ty reklamy na hledání pokladů?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I'm almost done gettin' ready for the scavenger hunt. Just need you to put those ads up all over the Valley.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Skoro jsem připravený na hledání pokladů. Jen potřebuji, abys vyvěsil/a ty reklamy po celém Údolí.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Get to Skull Rock and start the scavenger hunt!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Jdi ke Skále lebky a začni hledat poklady!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Did you find the scavenger hunt treasures inside Skull Rock?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Našel/la jsi poklady z hledání uvnitř Skály lebky?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: You found all the treasures? Okay, meet me at the top of Skull Rock for the prize ceremony.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Našel/la jsi všechny poklady? Dobře, sejdeme se na vrcholu Skály lebky na předávání cen.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Could ya go talk to Tiana? She's got the cakes for our first mini-game!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Mohl/a bys si promluvit s Tianou? Má dorty na naši první mini-hru!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hey {PlayerName}, could you bring those cakes you got from Tiana to my House?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hej {PlayerName}, mohl/a bys donést ty dorty od Tiany do mého domu?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Vanellope doesn't seem happy about this contest. I think we better talk about it.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Vanellope nevypadá nadšená z téhle soutěže. Myslím, že bychom si o tom měli promluvit.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I gotta go talk to Peter Pan and see if he has a new mini-game idea. He can be A LOT. Would you come with me, {PlayerName}?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Musím si promluvit s Petrem Panem a zjistit, jestli má nápad na novou mini-hru. Umí být DOCELA hodně. Šel/šla bys se mnou, {PlayerName}?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hold on! I gotta get a picture of the cakes on the table!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Počkej! Musím vyfotit dorty na stole!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hey! If you found all the scavenger hunt prizes, you should <Lore>meet me at the top of Skull Rock</Lore>.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hej! Pokud jsi našel/la všechny ceny z hledání pokladů, <Lore>sejdeme se na vrcholu Skály lebky</Lore>.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Ralph, that was EPIC!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ralfe, to bylo EPICKÉ!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Talk about exciting!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: To bylo vzrušující!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Aw, I thought I'd win for sure.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Aw, myslel jsem, že určitě vyhraju.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hey, thanks for playing, everyone! And now, it's my greatest pleasure to award the Prize of ALL PRIZES to my very best friend — VANELLOPE!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hej, díky za hraní, všichni! A teď je mi velkým potěšením předat Cenu VŠECH CEN mojí nejlepší kamarádce — VANELLOPE!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I thought I won?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Myslel/a jsem, že jsem vyhrál/a?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Like, we're sharing the prize?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Jako, sdílíme cenu?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: This is my villain origin story!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Tohle je můj padoušský příběh o původu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: What are you talking about, Ralph? I didn't win. I spent half the game trying to stand on Sulley's shoulders for a better vantage point.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: O čem to mluvíš, Ralfe? Nevyhrála jsem. Půlku hry jsem strávila snažením se vylézt Sulleymu na ramena pro lepší výhled.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Well, so long, chums! I'm gonna convince Sulley to help me look for more treasure here. He is freakishly tall!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: No, tak ahoj, kamarádi! Jdu přemluvit Sulleyho, aby mi pomohl hledat další poklady. Je děsivě vysoký!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: What? Oh. Okay. Bye, Vanellope...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Cože? Aha. Dobře. Ahoj, Vanellope...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: But you love winning! Don't you want the prize?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ale ty miluj vyhrávat! Nechceš cenu?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I love YOU, you big galoot. But fair's fair: The prize goes to {PlayerName}!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Miluju TEBE, ty velký cvalíku. Ale fér je fér: Cena patří {PlayerName}!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Vanellope's right. Sorry, {PlayerName}. I... I just wanted to make her happy. Anyway, your prize is — pause for effect — a <ActivityItem>Deluxe Prize Counter</ActivityItem>!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Vanellope má pravdu. Promiň, {PlayerName}. Já... jen jsem ji chtěl udělat šťastnou. Každopádně tvá cena je — dramatická pauza — <ActivityItem>Deluxe pult s cenami</ActivityItem>!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hope you enjoy it.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Doufám, že si to užiješ.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: You DON'T love it. I can tell! Aw, snapdragons.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Nelíbí se ti to. Vidím to! Aw, sakra.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Ralph, you big gummy bear, we eat desserts EVERY DAY. And I love it — really!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ralfe, ty velký gumídku, dezerty jíme KAŽDÝ DEN. A miluju to — fakt!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: It's just... well, we ate two cakes yesterday, and the day before that, and—
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Jen... no, včera jsme snědli dva dorty, a den předtím taky, a—

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: But now we have to do it <Lore>really</Lore> fast! And {PlayerName} is here! Doesn't that make it hardcore?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ale teď to musíme dělat <Lore>fakt</Lore> rychle! A {PlayerName} je tady! To z toho nedělá hardcore?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: It's a cute idea, Ralph!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: To je roztomilý nápad, Ralfe!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Maybe we can find a new mini-game?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Možná najdeme novou mini-hru?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Sounds like you do this a lot?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Zní to, jako to děláte často?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Cute is NOT hardcore! I want it to be cool for Vanellope!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Roztomilé NENÍ hardcore! Chci, aby to bylo cool pro Vanellope!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: YA— Wait, what?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: JA— Počkej, cože?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Aw, c'mon! I was only joking. We can eat cake, buddy!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Aw, no tak! Jen jsem si dělal srandu. Můžeme jíst dort, kámo!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: No, I'll think of something better!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ne, vymyslím něco lepšího!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Of course you will. I know you've got tons of game ideas in that freakishly ginormous head of yours.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Samozřejmě že vymyslíš. Vím, že máš spoustu nápadů na hry v té děsivě obrovské hlavě.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: That's right! And I know just what we're gonna do... {PlayerName}, thanks for getting these cakes. You can have 'em. 'Cause you might need the energy for my next SUPER AMAZING...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Přesně tak! A vím přesně, co uděláme... {PlayerName}, díky za ty dorty. Můžeš si je nechat. Protože budeš potřebovat energii na mou další SUPER ÚŽASNOU...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: ...MIND-BLOWING...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: ...OHROMUJÍCÍ...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: ...INTENSE-BEYOND-BELIEF MINI-GAME!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: ...NEUVĚŘITELNĚ INTENZIVNÍ MINI-HRU!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: FISHING!!!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: RYBAŘENÍ!!!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Great idea! Whaddaya say, Ralph? I know you've got tons of game ideas in that freakishly ginormous head of yours.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Skvělý nápad! Co říkáš, Ralfe? Vím, že máš spoustu nápadů na hry v té děsivě obrovské hlavě.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Well sure, but that's different! Now we have you.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: No jasně, ale to je jiné! Teď tu máme tebe.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: So, you want a new game for the three of you to play, huh?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Takže chcete novou hru pro vás tři, co?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Yep. Something exciting and not lame like fishing. Sorry, Ralph. No offense.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Jo. Něco vzrušujícího a ne trapného jako rybaření. Promiň, Ralfe. Bez urážky.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: None taken. But Peter, it's gotta be competitive. I've got a SUPER AWESOME prize. And a prize like that needs an awesome game!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Žádná urážka. Ale Petře, musí to být soutěživé. Mám SUPER ÚŽASNOU cenu. A taková cena potřebuje úžasnou hru!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Any ideas, Peter?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Máš nějaké nápady, Petře?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: We could play pirates?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Mohli bychom si hrát na piráty?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I was living my best life with cake and fishing.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Žil/a jsem si nejlíp s dortem a rybařením.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Gee...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hm...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: What if we have a <Lore>scavenger hunt</Lore> inside Skull Rock?!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Co kdybychom uspořádali <Lore>hledání pokladů</Lore> uvnitř Skály lebky?!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Skull Rock IS hardcore. I mean, it's shaped like a skull!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Skála lebky JE hardcore. Teda, je ve tvaru lebky!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Oh, and we can invite lots of Villagers, so there's LOTS of competition!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ó, a můžeme pozvat spoustu Vesničanů, takže bude SPOUSTA soutěžení!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Great idea! How can I help set it up?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Skvělý nápad! Jak můžu pomoct s přípravou?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Sound good, Vanellope?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Zní to dobře, Vanellope?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I'm gonna win the big mystery prize!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Vyhraju tu velkou záhadnou cenu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Glad you asked...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Rád, žes se zeptal/a...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: I saw this thing on the Internet called "ads"! They were super helpful, especially when they popped up right in your face.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Viděl jsem na Internetu takovou věc, co se jmenuje "reklamy"! Byly super užitečné, zvlášť když ti vyskočily přímo do obličeje.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: {PlayerName}, what if you made ads but out of paper or glass or somethin'? Here, take this to help you build the ads, and I'll head to Skull Rock and get everything else set up!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: {PlayerName}, co kdybys vyrobil/a reklamy z papíru nebo skla nebo tak? Tady, vezmi si tohle na výrobu reklam, a já zamířím ke Skále lebky a připravím všechno ostatní!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: It sounds great! How do we get the word out?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Zní to skvěle! Jak o tom dáme vědět?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: HA! Not if I win it first!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: HA! Jedině pokud ji nevyhraju první!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Not a chance, flyboy!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ani náhodou, létavče!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Hey Ralph, how do we get the word out so I have some real competition?
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hej Ralfe, jak o tom dáme vědět, abych měl opravdovou konkurenci?

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Nah, we played that yesterday. But it DOES give me a swell idea...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Ne, to jsme hráli včera. Ale DÁVÁ mi to skvělý nápad...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Sure, those are nice, if you wanna be bored. But not if you wanna win at something!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Jasně, ty jsou fajn, pokud se chceš nudit. Ale ne pokud chceš v něčem vyhrát!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Would ya look at this turnout? Nice work with those ads, {PlayerName}!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Podívejte se na tu účast! Pěkná práce s těmi reklamami, {PlayerName}!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Okay, listen up everyone: The rules are simple...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Dobře, poslouchejte všichni: Pravidla jsou jednoduchá...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: The scavenger hunt starts <Lore>as soon as you enter Skull Rock</Lore>.
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Hledání pokladů začíná <Lore>jakmile vstoupíte do Skály lebky</Lore>.

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: The first Villager to find <Lore>all three hidden treasures inside</Lore> wins the prize!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: První Vesničan, který najde <Lore>všechny tři ukryté poklady uvnitř</Lore>, vyhraje cenu!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: This. Is. So. COOL!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: To. Je. Tak. SUPER!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: Ready...
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Připravit...

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: He's planned a contest and I'm going to win!
WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.cz: Naplánoval soutěž a já vyhraju!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_020_VL.en: They are. I just put on the finishing touches. Here you go. Enjoy!
